title: The Salt of Ironhollow
author: Sable Montrose
blurb: Beatrix Dravenmoor, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
